card.name: TP ending in TTP and MTP
card.fires_on: The letters TP completing the abbreviations TTP (thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura) and MTP (microsomal triglyceride transfer protein), usually inside parentheses after the spelled-out term.

modes.label: TTP abbreviation
modes.description: TP closing the abbreviation for thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura, often alongside HUS.
modes.example: thrombocytopenia and hemolytic uremic syndrome/thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (HUS/T<<TP>>).

modes.label: MTP abbreviation
modes.description: TP closing the abbreviation for microsomal triglyceride transfer protein.
modes.example: Microsomal triglyceride transfer protein (MT<<TP>>) Inhibitor: lomitap

card.plain: It lights up on the last letters of the shorthand TTP or MTP when they appear after the full name.
